steps.what: Locate the current job order and check its identity
Read requirements to determine quantities, materials and work type

tasks.design: Use the current-order view in {DOCS} to reduce searching for revisions. The operator still reads the order and resolves ambiguous requirements before setup.
tasks.previous_blocker: Orders may be distributed across revisions and folders.
tasks.enabler_now: Native versioning and indexed views can reduce retrieval effort.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising contradictory material and finishing instructions.
tasks.human_edge: Understand whether the requested output can actually be produced.
tasks.altitude: Less document searching; production decisions are unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native versioned order retrieval could reduce searching; effort estimates are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers retrieving and reading orders, excluding machine setup and customer specification capture.

Order coordinator supplies job reference, revision, work type, quantity, stock and finishing requirements in the existing order. Coordinator capture stays unchanged; three other-role upkeep hours below cover revision-link maintenance. Operator checks identity in s1 and reads missing fields manually in s2; no free structured extraction is assumed.
Test native DOCS views before code; existing system runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Current revision control and actual searching effort
research_questions: Does one current-order view reduce retrieval without hiding amendments?

incremental.description: Maintain views and resolve stale links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gives10 gross minus4 upkeep=6 net. Already centralised orders yield zero; scattered revisions may yield2%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sort, assemble and proof completed work

steps.what: Sort and assemble completed work, then proof completeness and quality

tasks.design: Retain physical assembly and proofing against the job order. Existing collation on the {OTHER} office production machine can be used, but its existing runtime earns no new labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Physical defects and mixed finishing requirements need inspection.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional verified mechanism replaces handling in this proposal.
tasks.still_hard: Detect missing pages, poor impressions and incorrectly assembled sets.
tasks.altitude: Hands-on assembly and quality responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Document extraction capabilities do not establish replacement of physical sorting and proofing.

assumptions: Boundary is physical finished-work handling, excluding printing and downstream dispatch.
Operator compares actual sets with the existing order in s1; no structured quality or completeness flag is assumed.
Test native machine collation before any custom system; this proposal claims no extra saving from existing collation.
Zero upkeep because no new process or tool is introduced.
unknowns: Existing collation capability and output mix
research_questions: Which defects are visible only in finished physical sets?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; gross and net zero. Mixed physical output retains handling even where some machine collation already runs.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Gather production counts, materials used and unresolved backlogs
Complete production records with totals and outstanding work
Reconcile totals and accept the completed production record

tasks.design: Configure validated entry and summaries in the {SPREADSHEET} before considering an integration. The operator captures and reconciles actual output, waste, stock use and backlog; formulas only assemble the record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated copying and totals follow manual observation.
tasks.enabler_now: Validated tables and native formulas can generate repeatable records.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing completed units from waste and part-finished jobs.
tasks.altitude: Less record assembly while physical verification stays intact.

reach.learn: Separate observation errors from calculation errors

evidence.claim: Configured tables can calculate summaries from verified production facts; savings are an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is production recording only; physical production and billing are excluded.

Operator produces job id, period, good units, spoiled units, material type/quantity, remaining quantity and backlog reason in s1. Reading counters, counting physical output and field capture all retain s1 time; missing readings require manual reconciliation, never assumed zero.
Test native spreadsheet validation and formulas first; no saving from pre-existing counters or system runtime.
No employee speed monitoring is introduced; assess consultation and access requirements if scope changes.
unknowns: Counter reliability and current record format
research_questions: Can generated totals reconcile mixed good output and spoilage without extra recounting?

already_counted.description: Observe, reconcile and capture source facts

incremental.description: Maintain validation rules and handle changed job formats

approvals.approved_version: Exact reporting period, input fact versions and final record totals; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R60 gives40 gross minus7 upkeep=33 net. Already generated records yield zero; manual copying of repeat jobs may yield8%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate service prices and handle payment

steps.what: Check service quantities, customer details and applicable prices
Compute prices and prepare billing information
Check the charge, receive payment or provide supervisors with billing information
outputs: payment record or supervisor billing information

tasks.design: Configure existing service items and tariff calculations in the {ERP}. The operator verifies source facts and the final charge before receiving payment or handing billing information to the supervisor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated tariff arithmetic may be separate from service records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native price tables can calculate a draft from verified quantities.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving unusual work, disputed charges and cash discrepancies.
tasks.human_edge: Explain the charge and recognise exceptions.
tasks.altitude: Less price arithmetic; customer contact and charging authority stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep source amounts distinct from disputed transactions

evidence.claim: Native tariff calculation from verified quantities is plausible; no office-machine billing case establishes these savings.

assumptions: Boundary ends at payment receipt or supervisor handoff; supervisor invoicing remains outside and unchanged.

Operator captures service code, chargeable quantity, customer/account, tariff version, applicable tax code and authorised discount reference in s1. Missing codes or unusual charges go to manual clarification; capture time is retained.
Finance maintains tariff validity and tax configuration; five other-role incremental hours below cover additional maintenance and exception support.
Test native ERP pricing first; existing automated calculation yields no additional labour saving.
unknowns: Existing price automation and operator payment authority
research_questions: Which charges still require manual arithmetic after native price tables are configured?

already_counted.description: Charge check and payment or handoff

incremental.description: Maintain service mappings and review exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact customer, service quantities, tariff version, tax, discount and charge; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R70 gives30 gross minus6 upkeep=24 net. Existing automated prices yield zero; repeat manual tariff calculations may yield6%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less searching, record assembly and arithmetic; physical quality checks and payment handling remain.
reach: Coordinate with finance on tariff exceptions
role.ambitious_version: An operator who resolves production and billing discrepancies with a clear source trail.
